text:
Jen (sales): Hey team — Acme ML POC is hitting rate limits during a customer demo. They say the UI is returning 429s. Need a temporary per-org/per-key uplift. Org: acme-123, key ends with ...7f3c. Demo window: Mon 09:00 PT for ~4 hours, but customer asked for 48h fallback if issues persist. Can we do a conservative burst raise? @Omar @Maya
Omar (support): Can you paste the error sample and approximate QPS? Also need customer contact + confirmation they won't share keys.
Jen (sales): Error: "429 Too Many Requests" from /v1/generate. Logs show spikes ~350 rps, normally 40 rps. Customer contact is sara@acme.com. They've signed the addendum.
Maya (eng-platform): OK. Two quick options: (1) short-lived per-key override -> safe but need CLI/console change + audit, or (2) route demo traffic to dedicated pool if we can provision capacity fast. Which is possible?
Tomas (infra): Dedicated pool won't be ready in <24h. Per-key override is fastest. However we need an approval + an automated rollback + audit log. We shouldn't open a long-lived allowlist entry.
Jen (sales): Per-key override is fine. We just need a clear rollback and an audit entry for compliance.
Maya (eng-platform): I'll prepare the override and a small guard: capped qps, token-level annotation, and automatic revoke after 48h. Sample admin CLI I plan to run: ```bash
ri admin rate-override \
  --org acme-123 \
  --key sk-xxxxx7f3c \
  --qps 500 \
  --burst 1200 \
  --duration 48h \
  --reason "sales demo - Acme ML" 
```
Maya (eng-platform): Also adding a rollback cron job and an alert if token consumes >80% of burst or has >5% error rate. Will tag with audit id: demo-acme-2026-03-23.
Tomas (infra): Make sure we set a hard cap on token so it can't exceed dedicated-pool capacity and trigger cross-tenant degradation. Use routing policy: prefer-hosted, fallback-deny.
Omar (support): I'll notify customer and get Sara to confirm the exact start time. Also creating a support ticket: #SUP-8421. ops-bot created: ticket SUP-8421 (link: https://redwood.support/t/SUP-8421). :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Automated check detected the key has no prior override; adding temporary audit marker.
Jen (sales): Thanks — please ping me once override is applied and when revoke is scheduled.
Maya (eng-platform): Applying now. I'll post the exact command output and revoke time. :eyes:
thread_summary: Sales requests temporary per-key rate override for Acme ML demo; eng-platform to apply short-lived override with caps, audit id, and automatic revoke; infra asks for hard caps and routing policy; support opens ticket and gets customer confirmation.
